cards.text: Classic character planning uses STR, AGI, VIT, INT, DEX and LUK. Treat this public overview as advice; use the pinned server catalog for actual formulas and legal limits.
In Classic, allocated base stats differ from totals including bonuses. Raising higher base stats consumes more points. Do not infer a legal allocation or server-specific stat cap from this overview.
Renewal character planning uses STR, AGI, VIT, INT, DEX and LUK. This public overview does not establish equivalence with Classic or with the custom server's formulas.

In Renewal, base-stat allocation and bonus-inclusive totals are distinct. Higher base stats cost more points to raise. Exact point costs and class limits remain server-mechanics questions, not verified facts here.
